meta.text: Why does this work? Because one Spark session is bound to the notebook, so temp views are visible to every language context. That's the key insight — a Python variable stays in its own cell, but a registered view is shared. And watch the common pitfalls: running a cell while the cluster is still Pending, expecting %sql to see a raw Python variable, and forgetting that auto-stop terminates the cluster and clears notebook state.
